references.text: Delilah asks Samson the same question for the first time and urges him to tell her the secret behind his strength.
Delilah accuses Samson of lying to her again, using the same words that he has deceived her.
Delilah continues to press Samson and accuses him of not loving her because he keeps the secret hidden.
Samson's wife used similar tactics to get him to reveal the riddle, by crying and accusing him of not loving her.
The theme of deception in close relationships, where Adam blames the woman for his fall.
The words about being bound are also used in Proverbs as a metaphor for commitment and captivity.
